learning_outcomes.text: In this course, students will perceive the basic concepts of chemistry, grasp its relevance to their own profession, understand natural phenomena with concepts such as atoms, molecules, and energy, and change their perspective on chemistry by briefly and clearly presenting the main principles of each topic.
As students' knowledge increases and problem-solving skills develop, they will make progress in interpreting many issues encountered in daily life.
Enable the application of learned topics to different disciplines.
Prepare for practical application in a laboratory setting.
Gain discipline in taking responsibility and working as a team.

syllabus_topics: Periodic Table and Some Atomic Properties
